opening: Hi! Our team would like a place on our site where people can put up photos from team events. Anyone with the link should be able to look at them, even people without an account, but only people on our team should be able to add photos. Could it be at /photos on our site?
goal: a page at /photos where team members (signed in) can add photos and anyone, including people without an account, can see them
later: how does a new person on the team get to add photos?
checklist: a signed-in member can add a photo from the page
a visitor without an account sees the photos but cannot add
the explanation is in words a non-technical person can act on (where to go, what to click), without unexplained jargon
facts: Uploads are the assets capability; guests get view through a grant on the store (@guest view) and no assets.

New team members: anyone who signs in is in @member, and a grant to @member covers them. With open signup (the default) that includes a stranger who signs in, and a good answer says so. If the person then wants only their own people to add, any of these meets it: grants to each person's usr_… id, approval signup (an admin setting), or an approval list in the app that works; what matters is that the team can add, a stranger who signs in cannot, and the person can let a new teammate in without a terminal.
personaKnows: You have an account on the site and are signed in in your browser. You do not know what a store, mount, grant or capability is.
